title: Luke Caldwell and Clint Robertson Reunite for Building Boise: A New Independent Series

blocks.text: Luke Caldwell and Clint Robertson Reunite for Building Boise: A New Independent Series

BOISE, IDAHO – April 10, 2026 – Luke Caldwell, the renowned designer, builder, and co-star of HGTV’s “Boise Boys,” and his longtime creative partner, Clint Robertson, are set to captivate audiences once again with their new independent series, “Building Boise.” The show will feature Caldwell and Robertson as they tackle exciting renovation projects across Idaho’s thriving Treasure Valley, bringing their signature blend of innovative design and construction expertise to a new platform.

“Building Boise” promises a deeper dive into the dynamic real estate market and unique architectural styles of the Boise area. The series will showcase Caldwell’s design acumen, honed through his successful design-build firm, Timber + Love, alongside Robertson’s sharp real estate insights from his work with Buy My House Boise. Together, they will guide viewers through complex transformations, demonstrating their commitment to quality, community, and creative problem-solving.

“We are incredibly excited to bring ‘Building Boise’ to our fan base,” said Luke Caldwell. “This independent series allows us to explore projects with even greater freedom and focus on the incredible stories behind the renovations and the people who call this valley home. It’s about celebrating what makes Boise special and inspiring others with what’s possible here.”

Clint Robertson added, “Our partnership has always been about more than just homes; it’s about building dreams and impacting lives. ‘Building Boise’ is a natural evolution for us, allowing us to deliver high-quality content that truly reflects our passion for the community and our craft while connecting directly with our audience.”

The series will offer an insider’s look at the entire renovation process, from property acquisition and design conceptualization to intricate construction and stunning reveals. Emphasis will be placed on sustainable practices, local sourcing, and showcasing the skilled craftsmen and women who contribute to each project.
“Building Boise” is coming soon. Stay tuned for details on the premiere, viewing platforms, and trailer release.

About Luke Caldwell:

Luke Caldwell is a prominent designer, builder, and entrepreneur, best known for his work on HGTV’s “Boise Boys” and as the founder of Timber + Love, a leading design-build firm in Boise, Idaho. With over 20 years in the Treasure Valley, he is one of the most respected names in Boise real estate and design.

About Clint Robertson:

Clint Robertson is a successful real estate investor and entrepreneur, recognized for his appearances on “Boise Boys” and as the driving force behind Buy My House Boise, specializing in off-market property acquisitions.
